title: Datadog pricing (2026): what a small team actually pays
snippet:
Datadog is free for up to five Basic hosts with 1-day metric retention. Paid infrastructure monitoring starts at $15 per host a month billed annually ($18 on demand), APM adds $31 per host, and logs, custom metrics, containers and tests each have their own meter. Our worked bills for three to eight hosts come to about $160 to $670 a month.
Every number below is from Datadog's own pricing pages and billing docs, checked on November 3, 2026, and cited inline.1,2 Prices are US dollars list price, before any negotiated discount.

title: Datadog Pricing 2026: Costs, Free Tier, and Savings
snippet:
The short version: **Datadog pricing is modular.** Infrastructure Pro starts at $15 per host per month on annual billing. APM starts at $31 per host per month. Log Management charges $0.10 per ingested GB plus indexing, such as $1.70 per million indexed events at 15-day standard retention. The bill grows when traffic-driven meters grow faster than host count.

| APM | $31 annual, $36 on-demand | Host / month | Requires Infrastructure attached |
| APM Pro | $35 annual | Host / month | Higher APM tier features |

Datadog APM starts at $31 per host per month on annual billing and $36 on-demand when attached to Infrastructure. APM Pro and APM Enterprise list at higher annual host rates.

## Does Datadog have a free tier?
Yes. Datadog has a free tier for up to five Basic infrastructure hosts with 1-day metric retention. That is different from a free trial and different from a production plan.
Use the free tier to test basic infrastructure monitoring or learn the UI. Do not use it to estimate a production bill if you plan to use APM, log management, indexed spans, RUM, synthetics, Cloud Security, Observability Pipelines, custom metric overages, or Bits AI.
A production bill usually starts when you combine products. One host with Infrastructure is easy to estimate. The same host with APM, logs, RUM, custom metrics, synthetics and AI-assisted investigations is a different cost shape.

Datadog has a free tier for up to five Basic hosts with 1-day metric retention. It is different from the trial and does not cover the paid APM, log indexing, RUM, synthetics, Cloud Security or AI Credit usage covered in this guide.

The Datadog free tier covers up to five Basic infrastructure hosts with 1-day metric retention. It is useful for a small test, but it does not represent the bill for a production observability setup using APM, log management, RUM, synthetics, security products or Bits AI.
